text:
rachel-partners: Kickoff: AcmeCorp listing onboarding. Need owners for: AWS/GCP/Azure creds & IAM, legal amendments (KMS/rotation + SOC2 note), SKU packaging, staging screenshots, and a joint launch comms plan. Quick owners?

sam-cloud: I can cover cloud infra artifacts (IAM templates, example publisher assume flows, KMS snippets). Target: PR with templates by Wed.

mike-legal: I'll draft the marketplace addendum. Key asks from Acme: explicit key custody language, retention requirements, and audit log access windows. Need final SKU names to reference.

tara-product: I'll map SKUs and pricing tiers. Proposing: core-hourly, core-monthly, dedicated-reserved, private-onprem-trial. Will post a short CSV for manifest.

jo-ops: For trials we need trial entitlement metadata: duration, seat limits, auto-terminate flag. Also confirm support level text for the listing.

alex-eng: I'll take screenshots and a 90s demo video for the publisher portal. Need exact manifest and a staging publisher account.

rachel-partners: @sam-cloud include cross-account STS examples and a GCP service-account impersonation snippet. Also a short Azure role assignment example.

sam-cloud: Example GCP impersonate snippet (gcloud):
```bash
gcloud iam service-accounts add-iam-policy-binding acme-sa@project.iam.gserviceaccount.com \\
  --member='serviceAccount:publisher@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com' \\
  --role='roles/iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator'
```

sam-cloud: Azure role assignment example (az cli):
```bash
az role assignment create --assignee-object-id <PUBLISHER_PRINCIPAL_ID> --role "Contributor" --scope /subscriptions/<id>/resourceGroups/<rg>
```

mike-legal: Heads-up 1: I'll need the SKUs exactly as they will appear in the offer (no later than Tue) so contract language can reference them.

tara-product: I'll drop SKU CSV this afternoon. Also note billing metering unit for core-hourly = v-token-minute.

jo-ops: For telemetry tag in listing we need a telemetry contact and confirmation we can surface usage metrics in the marketplace. @rachel-partners can you confirm partner ok?

rachel-partners: Partner okayed sharing anonymized usage metrics. Will confirm telemetry email and legal-approved copy.

release-bot: Created doc: /docs/marketplace/acmecorp-manifest-draft.md

alex-eng: Started staging build. Requesting staging creds from @rachel-partners for acme-pub account. Will attach screenshots to the doc when ready.

rachel-partners: Sending staging creds via secure channel now.

sam-cloud: I'll open a PR for IAM templates and include Azure + GCP snippets. Link when ready.

mike-legal: Plan: amendment draft by Thu COB if SKUs land Tue. Will include KMS rotation window and audit log retention language.

tara-product: CSV uploaded to doc. SKU names: ["redwood-core-hourly", "redwood-core-monthly", "redwood-dedicated-reserved", "redwood-private-trial"].

jo-ops: Confirmed trial metadata fields and support email: support@redwood.com. Will add to manifest.

alex-eng: Uploaded screenshots to doc and small demo gif.

rachel-partners: Great. Next sync Fri 9:30am to finalize launch checklist and comms plan. Action items: @sam-cloud -> IAM PR; @tara-product -> final SKU CSV; @mike-legal -> amendment draft; @alex-eng -> staging screenshots. :thumbsup:

sam-cloud: Acknowledged.

mike-legal: Acknowledged, will review once SKUs present.

release-bot: Reminder: marketplace checklist template v2 added to repo.
